info.title: PaperIQ API
info.description: AI Exam Intelligence Platform — every feature helps students score better marks with less effort.

get.description:
Generate and download paper as PDF from questions in database.
IMPORTANT: This generates a PDF with 100% authentic MLRIT questions extracted from
original DOCX files. The questions are identical, but the format is PDF not DOCX.
Original DOCX files were discarded after extraction to database.

Views the browser-friendly PDF version of the paper.
If original was DOCX, this serves the server-converted PDF.

Returns papers with their parsed questions included.
B7 fix: joins questions so the Paper Viewer can display them.

CRITICAL: Uses relational join to ensure questions are never clipped before hitting client.
Alias for backward compatibility. Redirects to /download endpoint.

post.description:
Pre-generate PDF and cache to Supabase Storage CDN.

- First request: generates PDF (500ms-2s)
- Subsequent requests: served from CDN (10-50ms)

Can be called manually or triggered automatically after paper ingestion.

get.description:
Get CDN URL for a paper if it exists, otherwise return None.
Frontend can use this to decide whether to direct-link CDN or fallback to generation.

post.description:
Batch cache papers to CDN.
Use this to pre-warm the CDN cache for popular papers.

Runs in background to avoid timeout.
Queue question parsing for one paper or all extracted papers.
Synchronous parse — waits for result (use for testing).

get.description:
Parse a paper in memory and return structured questions WITHOUT storing.
Useful for verifying parse quality before committing to DB.
List questions with filters. Returns evidence trail (paper_id on each).

post.description: Get questions for multiple papers in one call.

get.description:
Single question with full evidence trail:
question -> paper -> original_url
Returns question counts by type, section, marks.

post.description:
Beta Student Experience: Synchronous analysis generation.
Returns complete report immediately (no background job).

Trigger an analysis job. Returns report_id immediately.
The heavy work runs in background.

Use this endpoint for manual/advanced analysis with full control.
For normal users, use POST /analysis/simple instead.

Simplified analysis for normal users.

Auto-infers from user profile:
- College, branch, regulation (from onboarding)
- Year range (last 5 years)

User only provides:
- Subject ID (from dropdown)
- Exam category (Mid-1, Mid-2, Semester)
- Exam attempt (Regular/Supplementary)

Everything else is automatic.

get.description: Returns the most recent non-expired cached report matching the params.
Returns current status of an analysis job.
Returns the full analysis report.

Gap #6: Evidence-based syllabus coverage analysis.
Maps questions with topic_tags to syllabus topics via fuzzy matching.
Returns per-unit and overall coverage percentages backed by real question evidence.

post.description:
Gap #7: Map questions → syllabus topics via fuzzy matching.
Populates question_topics junction table with confidence scores.
Idempotent — safe to re-run.

get.description:
Get question distribution by marks ranges.

Returns breakdown of questions into:
- 1-2 marks: Short answer questions
- 3-5 marks: Medium answer questions  
- 6-10 marks: Long answer questions
- 11+ marks: Very long answer / essay questions

post.description:
Generate a personalised study plan from an analysis report.
The report must belong to the same regulation as the request.

Simplified onboarding for MLRIT R22 CSE students.

Automatic context resolution:
- College: MLRIT (fixed)
- Branch: CSE (fixed for now)
- Regulation: R22 (inferred from semester)
- Year: Inferred from semester (2-1/2-2 → Year 2)

AI auto-detects:
- Skill level from CGPA and backlogs
- Academic risk level
- Study intensity needs

Returns learner profile with inferred characteristics.

get.description:
Get current learner profile.
Re-computes on every request to ensure fresh data.

put.description: Upsert user profile — updates only provided fields.

delete.description: Delete user account — removes user_profiles and learner_profiles.

post.description:
Force refresh learner profile.
Call this after:
- Mock exam completion
- Readiness score calculation
- Major study session

Get subjects by semester+regulation (no college_id required).

get.description:
List all R22 subjects (both 2-1 and 2-2).
Optionally filter by branch (CSE, IT, BS, HS) or semester (1 or 2).
Get subject info and available paper count.

post.description:
Full auto-pipeline for one R22 2-2 subject.

Steps (all automatic):
1. Crawl MLRIT portal → download matching archives
2. Extract docx files matching subject_code
3. Parse questions
4. Run analysis
5. Return report_id

Returns {job_id, status, subject_code, subject_name}

get.description: Poll job status. When status=completed, check error_log[0].report_id for the analysis.
